summary: Read an integer n in the closed range from 1 to 10^5. Take the binary writing of every integer from 1 through n and glue those writings together in increasing order, forming one long string of bits. Interpret that string as a binary integer, convert it to decimal, reduce it modulo 10^9 + 7, and write the remainder.
notes: The left column is this sample's input text and the right column is the text the program should print. Comparison ignores trailing newlines.
